segments.title: March
segments.text: Hello Kemps Corner! March is Main Character Month. Women's Day, Holi, and a whole studio full of people who deserve the spotlight. This month we hand it to them, and gently suggest they renew while standing in it.

segments.title: ₹25.7L
segments.text: So, the number. Our March target for Kemps Corner is 25.7 lakh rupees. That's 27 per cent more than last March. Ambitious, yes. Unreasonable, no.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 14.1 lakh rupees. That's 6 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 6.17 lakh, comebacks 3.08 lakh, and everything else 2.31 lakh. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 55 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 400 leads, 204 trials, and 55 buyers, with about 27 per cent of trials converting. Every five trials should become about one member. Make those first classes unforgettable.
Here's where the offers come in. Three offers carry 15.7 lakh rupees, which is 61 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Lift Like a Girl
segments.text: First up, for Women's Day, Lift Like a Girl. A free first Strength Lab class for newcomers, eighth to fourteenth of March. Women's Day isn't about flowers. It's about deadlifts. The plan is 17 buyers at about 17,200, so 2.92 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Bura Na Mano, Renewal Hai
segments.text: Next, for Holi, Bura Na Mano, Renewal Hai. A forty-eight hour window for members expiring in March. Three months at fifteen per cent off and a limited Holi tee. Colours wash out. Abs don't. The plan is 14 buyers at about 49,200, so 6.88 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Monogamy Is Overrated
segments.text: And finally, Monogamy Is Overrated. Renew this month and we pay for two classes in formats you've never tried. Members who play the field stay longer. That's data, not gossip. The plan is 30 buyers at about 19,700, so 5.91 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: No price discount; ≈17% value on a 12-class pack, ≈16% on 1M if the bonus is earned

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, Women's Day, with every free Strength Lab seat filled. Week two, Holi, and the forty-eight hour renewal window opens. Week three, nudge every member who has only tried one format. Week four, no March expiry leaves without a conversation.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's March at Kemps Corner. 25.7 lakh rupees, three offers, and 55 buyers to welcome. Everyone gets to be the main character. Our job is the plot.
